purpose: Final DBText bulk comparison with corrected codec interfaces and full representation accounting, per owner request.

timing.includes: Per-call codec initialization, dictionary reconstruction, and complete output reconstruction.
timing.excludes: File I/O, process startup, dynamic linking, compilation, input parsing, output allocation/prefault, correctness verification, artifact writes and cleanup.
timing.secondary: Decode-only durations are separately retained. Primary scores never remove actual decoding work performed inside lab_open.

size_accounting.formula: sum(original column bytes) / (sum(complete archive bytes) + custom decoder binary bytes)
included: row and block indexes where used
entire measured custom decoder shared library for LLM methods, once across all 23 columns
size_accounting.no_binary_deductions: Do not subtract statically included code from a custom decoder. Record exact binary SHA256 and byte count.
size_accounting.baseline_framing: General-purpose codec archives retain the historical uint64 original-size prefix. FSST column has uint64 original size plus uint32 table length. OnPair+ retains its unchanged author archive.

aggregation.factor: ratio of corpus totals; decoder charged once
aggregation.speed: sum(original column bytes) / median of seven sums of per-column open+decode seconds
aggregation.spread: min and max of the seven aggregate throughputs
aggregation.encoding: One observed encoding measurement per column, summed for corpus throughput; not a seven-trial median. FSST rows uses the author-reported training+compression duration.

configurations.FSST: Original FSST paper per-string API; shared symbol table, retained row offsets and serialized safety padding. All rows decoded.
configurations.FSST-column: Original FSST library with documented one-line sampling memory-safety repair, one complete LF-bearing column as one input string. Distinct from the OnPair+ artifact adaptation of FSST.
configurations.OnPair+: Unchanged author OnPairAdvancedCompressor<16>, cutoff=true and store_lengths=true, whole original column, fresh decode object per call.
configurations.LZ4-paper-1000: Historical paper row-block layout retained as a labeled diagnostic. Charge the actual indexed archive used for decoding, not the separate bare-size probe.
configurations.LLMs: Retained A1-A3 and G1-G4 binaries and archives; no model calls or algorithm changes.

coverage: All 30 original DBText methods, plus FSST column and LZ4 paper 1000-row diagnostic; 32 total.
interpretation: Bulk complete reconstruction. Whole-column compression does not establish random-row access. Both FSST configurations remain explicitly labeled pending supervisor preference.
published_artifacts: New output folder only. Preserve all earlier raw evidence, plots, and tables.
fsst_safety_repair: Both FSST configurations use the isolated pinned library plus FSST_SAFETY_PATCH.diff. FSST_REPAIR.json and FSST_REPAIR_BUILD.json retain source/library identities and a guard-page regression. Original source and failed attempt are preserved.
